subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful, unlocked after_compaction hooks receive a supported ctx.api.resetSession(reason?) contract that queues a current-session reset for the owning lifecycle to perform later?
rationale: This adds permanent plugin API and session-lifecycle semantics; code review can evaluate the implementation, but only an owner can confirm that plugins should receive this capability and that deferred acceptance without completion feedback is the intended contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow contract
options.body: Accept the after-compaction-only, current-session-scoped API after exact-head lifecycle proof and direct Codex contract inspection.

options.title: Keep reset ownership internal
options.body: Do not expose a plugin API yet; retain reset decisions inside core or owner-specific lifecycle code until a broader plugin contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contract
recommendation.body: Accept the after-compaction-only, current-session-scoped API after exact-head lifecycle proof and direct Codex contract inspection.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both the session-reset implementation and plugin-versus-core scope decisions.
